questions.q: Who tells the story in this chapter?
questions.evidence: The captain, the squire, and I were talking matters over in the cabin

questions.q: Why couldn't the cabin party simply overpower the six mutineers and sail away?
choices: The ship had a hole in it

questions.q: Who went ashore first with the doctor in the jolly-boat to look for information?
questions.evidence: Hunter and I should go ashore with the jolly-boat

questions.q: What tune was one of the men guarding the gigs whistling?
choices: "Fifteen men on the dead man's chest"

questions.q: What feature of the stockade especially pleased the doctor?
choices: A spring of clear water inside it
A secret tunnel to the beach
A store of food left by Flint
questions.evidence: What particularly took my fancy was the spring

questions.q: Why was the spring so important to the cabin party?
choices: They had no water on the ship
It was the only way off the island

questions.q: When the doctor heard the death cry ringing over the island, what was his first thought?
choices: That the squire had been shot
That a wild animal was attacking
questions.evidence: "Jim Hawkins is gone," was my first thought

questions.q: Where did they post Redruth to guard against the six mutineers?
choices: In the gallery between the cabin and the forecastle, with loaded muskets
At the top of the mast
questions.evidence: We put old Redruth in the gallery between the cabin and the forecastle

questions.q: What did the six mutineers do after the captain warned Mr. Hands?
choices: They went down the fore companion to attack from behind, but turned back when they saw Redruth
They jumped overboard and swam ashore
They surrendered and joined the captain
They fired a gun to signal Silver
questions.evidence: when they saw Redruth waiting for them in the sparred galley, they went about ship at once

questions.q: What did the cabin party do with the extra arms and powder they could not carry?
choices: Dropped them overboard into the water
Gave them to the six mutineers
questions.evidence: The rest of the arms and powder we dropped overboard

questions.q: The doctor says they set out "to provision the block house." To provision a place means to:
choices: Stock it with food and supplies
questions.evidence: set to provision the block house

questions.q: How did Abraham Gray show he chose to stay loyal to the captain?
choices: He fought his way out of the forecastle with a cut cheek and joined the captain
He shouted a warning to Silver
He refused to answer and stayed below
questions.evidence: out burst Abraham Gray with a knife cut on the side of the cheek

questions.q: What is the main thing that happens in this chapter?
choices: The loyal party moves supplies to the stockade and abandons the ship
The loyal party wins back the ship from the pirates
Silver makes peace with the captain
questions.evidence: I am leaving this ship, and I order you to follow your captain
